title: Nvidia presents LLaMA-Mesh: Generating 3D Mesh with Llama 3.1 8B. Promises weights drop soon.
author: fisj

comments.author: Azimn
comments.body: Now this is a big deal! Right now point cloud models keep getting better but for games this plus auto texturing could really change the dev pipeline. I honestly think in 2 years almost all 3d models will be generated or scanned maybe the main character will be human made for marketing or precise details.

replies.author: fisj
replies.body: Yeah, helping to fill out worlds with generated assets will help indies a lot, maybe make large RPGs more achievable. I do expect directable (tell the AI model what to change on existing 3d asset) AI Models at some point, but given this is only just coming in for 2D it may be quite some time for 3D. Theres just so much less data than 2D.
